text:
Maya (Finance): Heads up: we've published a short procurement update tied to the midyear ops refresh. Main changes affect short-term infra spend and vendor exception handling for cloud quota/patch emergencies. TL;DR below.

Alex K. (Eng): TL;DR please :eyes:

Maya (Finance): TL;DR: (1) Temporary single-invoice/card approval limit increased to $5,000 through Sep 30. (2) Fast-path GCP vendor exception for quota/patch/incident work (see form). (3) Contractors still require PO for amounts > $2k. (4) Client meal receipts must be itemized + purpose.

Jordan (ProdOps): Is the $5k change effective immediately? We have a VM rental billed yesterday.

Maya (Finance): Effective today. If you already submitted an invoice this week, add comment "ops-emergency" in the invoice portal so we can prioritize it.

Rajat (Purchasing): Exception flow (short version):
```
1) Fill the GCP Vendor Exception form: https://intranet/redwood/finance/gcp-exception
2) Include: project ID, estimated spend, reason (quota/patch/incident), approver suggestion and tagging (@Priya).
3) Purchasing triages within ~2 business hours. Finance signs off for <= $5k. >$5k goes to Director review.
```

Priya (Finance Partner): Add a one-paragraph justification and attach the vendor cost estimate PDF. Missing docs will delay the queue.

Alex K. (Eng): For short-term infra rentals under emergency, do we need both exception + PO?

Rajat (Purchasing): Exception alone covers ad-hoc infra up to $5k; Purchasing will run a PO in parallel. If you expect >$5k, open a PO and reference the exception ID.

approvals-bot: New exception created: #3517 (submitted by alex.kim). ETA review: 1h. Attachments: gcp-quotas.pdf

Alex K. (Eng): Uploaded the quote. Thanks.

Maya (Finance): A few operational clarifications: (a) This $5k bump is temporary and will be reassessed at quarter end. (b) Enterprise vendor onboarding and security reviews unchanged. (c) Finance office hours: Fridays 10:00am PT, 15 minutes for quick procurement questions.

Jordan (ProdOps): Can you share a short checklist we can paste into runbooks for outages?

Maya (Finance): Yes — I'll post a one-pager to #docs and add the link on the intranet. Also running a 20-minute Q&A this Friday.

Alex K. (Eng): This should make burst infra less painful. Appreciate it. :+1:

Maya (Finance): If you have active exceptions impacting customer-facing systems ping me or @Rajat directly and mark the form with `ops-emergency`. We'll prioritize those.

Rajat (Purchasing): Internal note: when filing, tag region (LA/NY/EU) so we route to appropriate procurement lead.

Priya (Finance Partner): Reminder: for client meals, we require itemized receipts even if paid on company card; pre-clear on the form when possible.

Maya (Finance): Posting summary + links now. Thanks all — please bring any unanswered procurement questions to Friday's session or DM me.
